title: APEDA Facilitates First-Ever Export of GI-tagged Mithila Makhana by Sea Route from Bihar to Australia
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 2:53PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: APEDA facilitated the first commercial sea shipment (18 MT) of GI-tagged Mithila Makhana from Bihar to Australia, providing nearly 18% higher price realization to farmers.
Bihar accounts for approximately 85% of India's Makhana production; a dedicated Harmonized System (HS) Code for Makhana came into effect under the Finance Bill, 2025 to streamline global trade.
The consignment was supported under APEDA's BHARATI initiative (incubating agritech and export innovations) in coordination with the Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates NUCFDC’s new premises in Mumbai and addresses the ‘Sahkar Nav-Kranti’ programme
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 6:23PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: National Urban Co-operative Finance and Development Corporation Limited (NUCFDC) has been operationalized as the official Umbrella Organisation for Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs) with RBI recognition and ₹306 crore mobilised capital.

Digital public tools introduced for UCBs include 'Bank in a Box' (comprising Sahkar CBS, Sahkar Cloud, loan origination), a dedicated Security Operations Centre, and AI-based 'MuleHunter' fraud-prevention systems.
NUCFDC signed an MoU with the National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) to extend low-cost cybersecurity, digital forensics, training, and research to all UCB branches.

Key regulatory relaxations for UCBs highlighted: Priority Sector Lending (PSL) target reduced from 75% to 60%, permission for up to 15% branch expansion without prior approval, One-Time Settlement (OTS) facility extension, and Member Lending Institution (MLI) status for collateral-free credit schemes.

title: XI BRICS CULTURE MINISTERS’ MEETING CONCLUDES IN BHOPAL; BHOPAL DECLARATION ADOPTED
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 1:54PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: The XI BRICS Culture Ministers' Meeting in Bhopal concluded with the adoption of the 'Bhopal Declaration' under India's BRICS Chairship theme: 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

The Declaration provides a framework for cultural and creative industries, UNESCO multinational nominations, provenance research, restitution of cultural property, and safeguarding Traditional Knowledge Systems.
India announced a pilot project to develop a 'Voluntary Artist Registry' to facilitate cross-border networking and professional mobility for creative practitioners across BRICS nations.
It emphasizes the protection of creators' rights, transparency, and fair remuneration regarding the use of copyrighted works in Artificial Intelligence systems.

title: DigiLocker Partners with AAERI to Fast-Track Document Verification for Indian Students Heading to Australia
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 10:48AM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) under MeitY partnered with the Association of Australian Education Representatives in India (AAERI) to launch 'AAERI Verify'.

The platform integrates DigiLocker to enable source-verified, paperless, and consent-based verification of academic, identity, and financial documents for Indian students applying to Australian universities.
Demonstrates the international application and cross-border expansion of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in solving global education verification challenges.

title: No Charges for UPI Users
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 6:40PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Government clarified that UPI will remain free for consumers and Person-to-Person (P2P) transactions; any future Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) will be threshold-based, nominal, and applied strictly to specific merchant transactions.

The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposes to amend Section 10A of the Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007 to establish an enabling statutory framework for long-term sustainability and technological upgrades.
Post-legislation, the 'UPI and Services Steering Committee' headed by NPCI will decide on merchant thresholds and MDR rates.
As of July 2026, UPI processed 2,366 crore transactions worth ₹29.9 lakh crore, and is currently operational in 11 foreign countries.

title: E-Samudra launched as India Accelerates Digital Transformation of Maritime Governance
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 5:49PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways launched 'E-Samudra', a unified digital platform providing faceless, paperless, and time-bound services for seafarers and shipping entities.
Integrated key digital modules include e-NAVIK (24×7 grievance redressal), Digital Seafarers Employment Agreement (d-SEA), and the Seafarer Tracking Dashboard.

Highlights legal and strategic policy frameworks including the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 (which statutory recognizes seafarers as 'Key Workers'), Maritime India Vision 2030, and Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047.
India has emerged as the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers, growing from 1.03 lakh in 2013 to over 3.23 lakh active workforce in 2025.

title: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation’s Inter-Caste Marriage and Atrocity Victims Relief Schemes Merged with Centrally Sponsored Scheme from March 31, 2023
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 7:07PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Dr. Ambedkar Scheme for Social Integration through Inter-Caste Marriages and the Relief to SC/ST Victims of Atrocities Scheme were merged into a single Centrally Sponsored Scheme with effect from March 31, 2023.

The standalone schemes were subsumed under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for the Implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights (PCR) Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
The administrative restructuring aims to prevent operational duplication and streamline Central assistance disbursed to State Governments and UT Administrations.

title: Where Every Purchase Finds a GeM
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 4:37PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Government e-Marketplace (GeM), established in August 2016 following General Financial Rules (GFR) amendments, serves as India's central digital public procurement ecosystem.
Key targeted inclusion sub-initiatives under GeM include SWAYATT (startups and youth), Womaniya (women-led MSEs and WSHGs), SARAS Collection (rural SHG goods), and Startup Runway 2.0.

Fintech and facilitation mechanisms include GeMSahay (mobile app providing instant, collateral-free working capital loans via Union Bank of India) and GeM Suvidha Kendras established in partnership with CSC-SPV.

Interoperability enhancements involve integrating GeM with the Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP), Indian Railway Electronic Procurement System (IREPS), and Defence Public Procurement Portal (DPPP).

title: Union Minister J P Nadda releases Knowledge Paper on ‘AI in MedTech: Revolutionizing Healthcare Through Artificial Intelligence’
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                08 AUG 2026 5:52PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Knowledge Paper released on 'AI in MedTech: Revolutionizing Healthcare Through Artificial Intelligence' by the Department of Pharmaceuticals in association with FICCI.
Key Foundations Identified: Highlights existing initiatives including Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), IndiaAI Mission, SAHI, BODH, and the National Medical Devices Policy, 2023.

Major Ecosystem Challenges: Identifies fragmented health data, lack of lifecycle-based regulation for adaptive AI, and absence of structured procurement/reimbursement pathways as key barriers to large-scale clinical adoption.
Priority Focus Areas: Highlights AI-enabled diagnostics as the primary immediate application to bridge specialist shortages in primary and secondary healthcare.
